node.label: peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase deficiency
node.definition: Peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase deficiency is a rare neurodegenerative disorder that belongs to the group of inherited peroxisomal disorders and is characterized by hypotonia and seizures in the neonatal period and neurological regression in early infancy.

mechanism_classes.label: peroxisomal biogenesis / peroxisomal enzyme or transporter defect
